about: The rule linter's mapping lists (scripts/lint/java_ts.js mappingLists). invented: the list of invented names for the exported items and public members, each with the reason it has no Java counterpart (javascript/CLAUDE.md, JavaScript Binding Conventions, Scope and Layout and modules). javaTargets: the Java class or member of an item the naming convention does not find; an entry that places a class outside its Java package's folder is {java, reason}, with the reason of that deviation from one import path per Java package (check-invented-names). nativeCallers: the classes, exports and modules, outside the wrappers the JavaScript Binding Conventions name (Implementation over the FFI), that call the addon, each with the reason the rules give (check-native-wrappers). An export is keyed src/<module>.ts:<Name>, a member <Class>.<member>, one named by a well-known symbol <Class>.[Symbol.<name>]; a class of nativeCallers is keyed src/<module>.ts:<Name>, exported or not, and a module's top-level code src/<module>.ts.

src/common/header/record_header.ts:Recor.reason: (deviation, as in Python) Java's RecordHeader is in common.header.internals, and one import path per Java package would make the class apps build headers with public under an internals path. Why: it belongs beside Header and Headers, as Python's header class sits in confluent_kafka.common.header (javascript/CLAUDE.md, JavaScript Binding Conventions, Serialization)

nativeCallers.src/common/kafka_future.ts:KafkaFutureIm: a future over a native handle, a record's (Java's FutureRecordMetadata, over the native future of its hand-over) or an admin RPC's: on a future over a native handle, get() calls kafka_common_KafkaFuture_get_cb and get({ timeout }) kafka_common_KafkaFuture_get_with_timeout_cb (javascript/CLAUDE.md, JavaScript Binding Conventions, Futures and waiting)
nativeCallers.src/admin/mock_admin_client.ts:Builder: MockAdminClient's nested Builder, over the FFI's mock builder (kafka_admin_MockAdminClient_Builder_new_err, its set_<field> functions and kafka_admin_MockAdminClient_Builder_build): the mock wraps the FFI's mock (javascript/CLAUDE.md, JavaScript Binding Conventions, Implementation over the FFI: Only KafkaProducer, KafkaConsumer, the admin client and the three mocks call the addon, because the mocks wrap the FFI's mocks), its setters making the FFI's set_<field> call only for the setters that ran (Class family, the option classes)
